summary.text: Irene Haines, a Republican, represents the 34th District, which includes East Haddam, East Hampton and Salem; she was first elected in November 2018 and to a fourth term in November 2024.

paragraphs.text: She is an Assistant House Republican Leader.
She has lived in East Haddam since 1996 and has worked as an insurance sales agent, marketing manager and small business owner.
She has been President of the East Haddam Business Association and a Girl Scout troop leader.
